config/settings/development.py: DEBUG=True, SQLite fallback if DATABASE_URL not set
config/settings/production.py: DEBUG=False, PostgreSQL required, ALLOWED_HOSTS from env
Strawberry GraphQL schema endpoint at /graphql with GraphQL playground in DEBUG mode
Django admin configured at /admin/

pytest-django configured in pyproject.toml (DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE, test paths)

ruff configured in pyproject.toml

title: Campaign CRUD GraphQL API
description: GraphQL mutations and queries to create, read, update, and soft-delete campaigns using Django + Strawberry.
acceptance_criteria: Campaign Django model with: id (UUID), name, description, status, createdAt, updatedAt, isDeleted (indices on isDeleted, status)
Django migration created for Campaign model (idempotent and reversible)
GraphQL mutation createCampaign returns created campaign
GraphQL query campaigns returns paginated list
GraphQL query campaign(id) returns single campaign with content pieces
GraphQL mutation updateCampaign updates campaign fields
GraphQL mutation deleteCampaign soft-deletes a campaign
Input validation rejects empty name and malformed payloads
Django admin registered for Campaign model
test_requirements: Unit test for Campaign model: create, get_by_id, update, delete, list_all
GraphQL query tests for campaigns and campaign(id)
GraphQL mutation tests for create, update, delete
Test validation rejects empty name
Test soft delete sets isDeleted=True
python manage.py makemigrations runs without errors
python manage.py migrate applies cleanly
done_when: All tests pass (≥80% coverage on campaigns app)
Security reviewer has confirmed no secrets exposed
API can be tested via GraphQL playground

title: Content Piece CRUD GraphQL API
description: GraphQL mutations and queries for content pieces within a campaign using Django + Strawberry.
acceptance_criteria: ContentPiece Django model with: id (UUID), campaignId (FK), headline, description, body, language, state, originalId, createdAt, updatedAt, isDeleted
GraphQL query contentPieces(campaignId) returns list
GraphQL query content(id) returns single content piece
GraphQL mutation createContentPiece creates with campaignId
GraphQL mutation updateContent updates fields
GraphQL mutation deleteContentPiece soft-deletes
Content belongs to a campaign (foreign key constraint)
Content state defaults to 'draft' via Django EnumField
test_requirements: Unit test for ContentPiece model
GraphQL query tests for contentPieces and content(id)
GraphQL mutation tests for create, update, delete
Test that content cannot be created for non-existent campaign (404)

title: AI provider abstraction layer (OpenAI + Anthropic)

title: AI draft generation GraphQL mutation
description: GraphQL mutation that takes a content brief and generates an AI-powered draft.
